name: Strassen

meta.title: Cleaning services in Strassen
meta.description: Home cleaning, housekeeping and office cleaning in Strassen, just west of Luxembourg City.

intro: Just west of the capital, Strassen mixes quiet residential streets with businesses along the route d'Arlon. We serve both.
paragraphs: Strassen's houses and apartment buildings are home to many families and professionals who work in the city. Regular home cleaning on a fixed day, with the same cleaner, is the service most requested here.
Businesses along the route d'Arlon and in the commune's office buildings rely on us for scheduled office cleaning and for showroom and retail spaces kept ready for customers.
